GOAL: Electron transport ki energy proton gradient ke zariye ATP banane tak kaise pahunchti hai?
MISAAL: Baandh aur turbine: paani jama karna proton gradient banana hai, aur turbine se niyantrit bahav ATP synthase se proton return hai.

LESSON
[p010-i14]
Humne dekha ki cyclic aur non-cyclic electron flow dono ATP formation se judte hain.
Aaj ka sawaal hai: electron transport ki energy proton gradient ke zariye ATP banane tak kaise pahunchti hai?
Thylakoid ki thaili yaad karo: membrane ke andar lumen hai aur uske bahar stroma hai.
H⁺ positive charge wale hydrogen ions hain; ab inki membrane ke dono taraf ki haalat dekhenge.
Ek taraf H⁺ zyada aur doosri taraf kam ho, toh membrane ke across fark ban jaata hai.
Concentration aur electrical haalat ke is fark ko proton gradient kehte hain.
Membrane protons ko bina rok-tok paar nahi jaane deti, isliye yeh fark bana reh sakta hai.
Isi fark aur protons ke membrane paar bahne ko ATP formation se jodne wali explanation chemiosmotic hypothesis hai.
Respiration mein bhi ATP synthesis proton gradient se judi hai, lekin jama hone ki jagah alag hai.
Mitochondria mein outer aur inner membranes hoti hain; unke beech ki jagah intermembrane space kehlaati hai.
Aage respiration mein dekhenge ki ETS mein electrons chalne par protons wahaan jama hote hain; abhi bas yeh location yaad rakho.
Chloroplast mein protons thylakoid lumen mein jama hote hain, mitochondrial intermembrane space mein nahi.

[analogy]
Baandh ke peeche jama paani socho, jise deewar turant doosri taraf nahi behne deti.
Paani jama karne se dono taraf fark banta hai; turbine ke raaste bahne par wahi fark kaam karva sakta hai.
Yahaan deewar thylakoid membrane hai, jama paani lumen ke H⁺ hain, aur turbine ATP synthase hai.
Pehle fark banana padega, phir uske niyantrit bahav ki energy kaam mein aayegi.

[p010-i15]
Ab electron excitation aur transport ko isi naye sawaal se phir dekhenge: H⁺ ka fark banta kahaan se hai?
Activation of electrons wahi light milne par electron ka excited hona hai, jise hum dono photosystems mein dekh chuke hain.
Pehle teen causes jodenge: water splitting, H carrier ka proton transfer, aur NADP⁺ reduction mein stromal protons ka lagna.
Uske baad dekhenge ki bana hua fark ATP synthase ko kaise chalaata hai.

[p010-i16]
Pehla cause water splitting hai; uski machinery PS II ke lumen-facing side par thi.
Do water molecules tootne se chaar H⁺, chaar electrons aur ek O₂ milte hain.
Isliye yahaan bane protons ko membrane paar laane ki zaroorat nahi; woh seedhe lumen mein nikalte aur jama hote hain.
Baandh ki tasveer mein samjho, yeh paani seedha jama hone wali taraf pahunch raha hai.

[p011-i20]
Doosre cause mein protons bahar ke stroma se andar ke lumen tak pahunchte hain.
Primary acceptor yaad karo, jo reaction centre se nikla electron sabse pehle leta hai.
Outer side ki acceptor kadi se electron aise carrier tak pahunchta hai jo electron ke saath hydrogen ka hissa bhi le sakta hai.
Isi ko H carrier kehte hain; yeh sirf electron aage dene wale carrier se is kaam mein alag hai.
Electron lete samay yeh stroma se H⁺ bhi leta hai.
Inner side par electron agle carrier ko dene ke saath H⁺ lumen mein chhod deta hai.
Is tarah electron transfer se juda kaam proton ko stroma se lumen tak pahunchata hai.

[p011-i21]
Teesra cause samajhne ke liye NADP⁺ se NADPH banne wala aakhri step yaad karo.
NADP⁺ electrons lekar reduced carrier NADPH banta hai; electron lena hi reduction hai.
NADP reductase membrane ke stroma side, yaani stroma ki taraf wale chehre par hota hai.
PS I ki acceptor kadi se aaye electrons ke saath is reaction ko stromal H⁺ bhi chahiye.
Reaction ka hisaab hai: NADP⁺ + 2e⁻ + H⁺ → NADPH.
Isliye stroma mein bache protons ghatte hain, aur lumen se unka fark aur badhta hai.
Aksar hum ise bhi proton ko lumen pahunchana samajhte hain, par yahaan H⁺ stroma mein reaction ke andar lag raha hai.

[p011-i22]
Ab teenon ka mila hua nateeja dekho: lumen mein H⁺ jama ho rahe hain aur stroma mein H⁺ ghat rahe hain.
Thylakoid membrane ke dono taraf proton gradient isliye mazboot hota hai.
Acidity batane wale scale ko pH kehte hain; H⁺ concentration badhne par pH ghatta hai.
Isliye lumen mein protons badhne ka matlab uske pH ka naapne layak ghatna hai, badhna nahi.

[p011-i23,p011-i24,p012-i1]
Abhi humne proton gradient bante dekha, lekin ATP banne ka step abhi baaki hai.
Toh proton gradient mein hamari itni dilchaspi kyun hai?
Proton gradient mein dilchaspi isliye hai kyunki uske ghatne par milne wali energy ATP synthesis chalaati hai.
Baandh ka jama paani ab turbine ki taraf bahne do: yahaan H⁺ lumen se stroma ki taraf lautte hain.
Is fark ke ghatne ko breakdown of this gradient kehte hain; protons nasht nahi hote.
Lekin unka lautna ek khaas enzyme, ATP synthase, ke raaste hota hai.
ATP synthase ke do hisse hain: membrane mein dhansa CF₀ aur stroma ki taraf nikla CF₁.
CF₀ ek transmembrane channel banaata hai; transmembrane ka matlab membrane ke aar-paar phaila hua hai.
Protons apne gradient ki disha mein is protein channel se lumen se stroma jaate hain.
Protein ke raaste aise paar jaane ko facilitated diffusion kehte hain; yahaan unhe ulte gradient ke khilaaf nahi dhakela ja raha.
CF₁ membrane ke outer surface par stroma ki taraf nikla hota hai, lumen ki taraf nahi.

[p012-i2]
Ab proton return ko CF₁ ke kaam se jodo; ADP aur inorganic phosphate se ATP banana energy maangta hai.
Gradient ghatne se milne wali energy CF₁ ki three-dimensional banawat badalti hai.
Protein ki banawat ke is badlav ko conformational change kehte hain.
Isi badlav se ATP synthase several molecules of energy-packed ATP bana sakta hai.
Yaani sirf protons jama karna kaafi nahi; unke lautne ki energy enzyme ke kaam se judni chahiye.

[example]
Ek transported proton ko chuno: woh pehle stroma mein tha, phir H carrier ne use lekar lumen mein chhoda.
Ab wahi H⁺ CF₀ channel se hokar stroma mein laut sakta hai.
Is safar mein proton mita nahi; pehle bana hua fark uske lautne se ghata.
Us return ki energy CF₁ ke banawat-badlav aur ATP formation se judi hai.

[p011-i1]
Ab Figure 11.7 mein isi kahani ko jagahon aur arrows ke saath jodo; is ATP-making process ko chemiosmosis kehte hain.
Thylakoid membrane band thaili ki boundary hai; uske bahar Stroma aur Stroma (low H⁺) likha hai.
Andar Lumen (high H⁺) hai, kyunki yahaan H⁺ concentration zyada hai.
Light ki arrows P680, PS II aur P700, PS I dono tak pahunchti hain; PS ka matlab Photosystem hai.
P680 ke paas H₂O se Oxidation of water ki arrow ½O₂ + H⁺ ki taraf jaati hai.
½O₂ ek water ke oxygen ka anupaat hai; actual gas poore O₂ molecules mein nikalti hai.
Ab electron ki disha pakdo: PS II se PQ, ya Plastoquinone, tak aao.
PQH₂ usi carrier ka electrons aur hydrogen liya hua roop hai; yahaan stromal H⁺ lene ka sambandh dikhta hai.
Aage Cytochrome B6f membrane complex hai, jiske paas proton arrow lumen ki taraf hai.
Uske baad PC, ya Plastocyanin, electron ko P700, PS I tak pahunchata hai.
PS I ki light excitation ke baad electron Fd, ya Ferredoxin, se FNR tak jaata hai.
FNR, Ferredoxin–NADP⁺ reductase, wahi enzyme hai jo NADP⁺ reduction karaata hai.
NADP⁺ + H⁺ se NADPH ki arrow stromal proton ke reaction mein lagne ko dikhati hai.
Repeated H⁺ marks aur green arrows ab alag dekho: andar jama hona, carrier se aana aur ATP synthase se lautna.
High Electrochemical Potential Gradient se Low ki taraf wedge lumen se stroma ki energy direction batati hai.
Electrochemical mein concentration ka fark aur ion ke electrical charge ka asar, dono shaamil hain.
Return arrow CF₀ se hokar stroma ki taraf jaati hai; uske saath CF₁, ATP synthase ka head, juda hai.
Head ke paas ADP + Pᵢ se ATP ki arrow hai; Pᵢ wahi inorganic phosphate hai.
Is tarah electron arrows gradient banne se judti hain, aur proton-return arrow ATP formation se.

[checkpoint]
Ab clue dono jagahon par mila: H⁺ lumen mein zyada hain aur ATP synthase ka head stroma ki taraf hai.
Ruko, pehle khud socho: ATP formation se juda proton bahav lumen se stroma hoga ya stroma se lumen?
ATP formation se juda bahav lumen se stroma hoga, kyunki protons CF₀ se apne gradient ki disha mein lautkar enzyme ko energy dete hain.
Ulti disha mein protons jama karna fark banaane ka kaam hai; us fark ko istemal karna return ka kaam hai.

[p012-i3]
Ab poora process chaar zaroori hisson ke saath ek baar jodo: membrane, proton pump, proton gradient aur ATP synthase.
Energy lagakar H⁺ ko membrane ke paar jama karne wali machinery ko proton pump kehte hain.
Pehle energy se proton fark banta hai, jisme thylakoid lumen ke andar H⁺ concentration zyada hoti hai.
Water splitting lumen ko protons deti hai, carrier stromal protons andar pahunchata hai, aur NADPH formation stroma ke protons ghataati hai.
Phir protons ATP synthase ke channel se waapas diffuse karte hain.
Is return ki energy enzyme ko ATP formation ke liye chalaati hai; isi jude hue process ko chemiosmosis kehte hain.
Baandh ki tarah pehle fark mein energy jama hui, phir niyantrit bahav se kaam hua.

[p012-i4]
Ab ATP ban gaya, aur electron movement se NADPH bhi mil chuka hai.
Dono turant stroma mein chalne wali biosynthetic, yaani naye organic substances banaane wali, reactions ke kaam aate hain.
ATP energy deta hai aur NADPH electrons deta hai, jaisa hum dono ke alag roles mein dekh chuke hain.
In reactions mein CO₂ ka carbon organic molecule mein judta hai; isi ko fixing CO₂ kehte hain.
Aage dekhenge ki yeh carbon sugars tak kaise pahunchta hai; abhi jagah yaad rakho, yeh kaam stroma mein hota hai.

BRIDGE: Ab light energy ATP aur NADPH ke roop mein kaam ke layak hai; agla sawaal hai ki stroma inhe sugars banane mein kaise istemal karta hai?
